title: Calibrator
summary: A low-friction probability elicitation instrument: paste a ranked session of questions as TOON from an external generator, answer each with one 0–100% slider (no default, first answer kept, later moves recorded as revisions), go Back, Skip with one tap, and copy the answered session back as TOON with every question answered, skipped or unseen. Progress is saved on the device; no network, accounts or question generation. Answered questions join the Published Corpus as calibration records from raw.toon.
